name: Changshu
registryBasis: The Changshu Natural Resources and Planning Bureau is responsible for unified registration of natural resources and real estate, cadastral investigation, and surveying. The city’s published basic-survey plan describes a public “Tianditu·Changshu” map service, but the reviewed material establishes base mapping rather than parcel feature access.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The official public map reference is to general Tianditu mapping. No public parcel geometry schema or anonymous full-polygon query was documented in reviewed city sources.
scopeLimits: City-local natural-resource/registry remit and published public map-plan material reviewed. No registry announcement row, owner/address, transaction, tax, or property query was used.
remainingUncertainty: A separate registry cadastral map may exist outside the public base-map service; no anonymous route was verified.
